figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1 | Genome mining and reconstruction of lanthipeptide gene clusters. 
The equivalent system for lasso peptides is shown in Extended Data Fig. 3. 
a, HMP genomes were scanned for RiPP gene clusters using antiSMASH 4.0. 
Lanthipeptide gene clusters are grouped by sequence identity (Methods). The 
nodes coloured red are gene clusters selected for heterologous expression. The 
complete RiPP network is shown in Extended Data Fig. 1 and lanthi/lasso peptides 
in Extended Data Fig. 2. b, AntiSMASH 4.0 was used to identify biosynthetic gene 
clusters (BGCs). Nodes represent individual clusters coloured by biosynthetic 
class. BGC nodes linked by edges have similar gene cluster architectures 
(Methods). An example of a native gene cluster is shown. The precursor peptide 
was expressed, cyclized by the lanthionine synthetase (LanM, blue) and the core 
proteolytically released by a protease (LanP, red). Additional tailoring enzymes 
may also be encoded in the gene cluster, which we label as hypothetical enzymes 
(LanH, red). The grey genes encode transporters, regulators and immune factors. 
To build the synthetic gene cluster, each gene was codon optimized (dashed 
lines) and placed under the control of a synthetic ribozyme insulator, RBS and 
terminator. The precursor peptide was fused to RSTN. c, An example synthetic 
gene cluster is shown along with synthetic genetic parts (Supplementary Table 
5). The components of the RSTN tag are shown (black, His6-tag; dark blue, SUMO; 
orange, TEV protease site; white, linkers). A TEV protease site (orange) was added 
after the leader (light blue) in the precursor peptide and this leaves an N-terminal 
glycine on the core (black circle). Dashed lines in the genome indicate the 
presence of other inducible systems in the E. coli Marionette-X strain.

Fig. 2 | RiPP modifications deduced by mass spectroscopy. a, This MS 
trace shows a candidate modified peptide consistent with four dehydrations. 
The LANII-298 precursor peptide contains five dehydratable residues 
(yellow); therefore, five hypothetical structures can be generated from four 
dehydrations (blue residues). b, LC–MS/MS of the species with candidate 
mass (1,795.9583) yields fragments consistent with the structure proposed 
for LANII-298, specifically where residues 5, 6, 15 and 27 are dehydrated.
